OCR request returning multiple pages of document content

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.ocr_async(LiterLlm::OcrRequest.new(document: { 'type' => 'document_url', 'url' => 'https://example.com/multipage.pdf' }, model: 'mistral/mistral-ocr-latest'))
puts result.pages.inspect
puts result.pages[0].index.inspect
puts result.pages[1].index.inspect
```
